assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks.
Diagnosis code I34.0 corresponds to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Diagnosis code G45.9 corresponds to personal history of transient ischemic attacks.
The service addresses clinical need defined by diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and I34.0.
